description: This file defines the DefaultHtmlRouteProvider class in Drupal, responsible for generating routing definitions for entity types, including routes for add, edit, delete, collection, and other entity-related pages.

classes.name: DefaultHtmlRouteProvider
classes.description: Provides routing definitions for entity types in Drupal, including routes for add, edit, delete, view, and collection pages.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the route provider using the service container and entity type.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Generates a collection of routes for a given entity type, including add, edit, delete, canonical, collection, and delete multiple routes.

methods.name: getAddPageRoute
methods.description: Returns the route for the add page of an entity type if it has a link template and bundle.

methods.name: getAddFormRoute
methods.description: Returns the route for the add form of an entity type, with bundle support and access control.

methods.name: getCanonicalRoute
methods.description: Returns the canonical view route for an entity type if available.

methods.name: getEditFormRoute
methods.description: Returns the edit form route for an entity type.

methods.name: getDeleteFormRoute
methods.description: Returns the delete form route for an entity type.

methods.name: getCollectionRoute
methods.description: Returns the collection/list route for an entity type if permissions and link templates are available.

methods.name: getEntityTypeIdKeyType
methods.description: Determines the type ('integer' or other) of the entity ID key for an entity type.

methods.name: getDeleteMultipleFormRoute
methods.description: Returns the route for deleting multiple entities if supported.
